tasks.subject: Task 0: Bootstrap modules and cabal wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Three compiling empty modules registered in cabal; build stays green.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Wok.IR.Name - opaque identity + deterministic supply
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Unique/Name/JoinId with identity-only equality and a pure fresh-name supply (State Int, no IORef).

**Files:** src/Wok/IR/Name.hs; test/Spec.hs (group IRName)

**Verify:** cabal test --test-options="-p IRName"

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/Wok/IR/Name.hs","test/Spec.hs"],"verifyCommand":"cabal test --test-options=\"-p IRName\"","acceptanceCriteria":["Name Eq/Ord on unique only","fresh supply monotonic+deterministic","same-hint diff-unique unequal","no IORef/unsafePerformIO"]}
```
